summary: Conversation and terminal views retry once in the same document, then offer Reload and retry after a second rejection without automatically discarding drafts or selection.

schema.detail: No stored or wire schema change.

compatibility.detail: Explicit reload recovery uses existing draft and workspace selection persistence. Markdown highlighting is unchanged pending the Pierre cutover.

downtime.detail: Takes effect in the next web build; no daemon restart.

manual.detail: No operator action. Recovery requires an explicit user click.

recovery.detail: Revert this change and rebuild the web application.
